source.section: Form OR-40 line 11 and Pub OR-17 PDF p.83 'Social Security benefits'; Form OR-40 lines 7-19, 20, 24-25, 27-29 (PDF p.3-4); instructions PDF p.16 line 17 and Table 5, PDF p.16-17 line 20 and tax tables, PDF p.32 Chart S and Chart J, PDF p.17-18 line 25 and Exemption credit worksheet; Pub OR-17 PDF p.143 marginal rates

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = private pension (person 0) 85,000.00 + taxable Social Security 20,400.00 = 105,400.00. Social Security gross 24,000.00, federal taxable part 20,400.00 by the federal worksheet. Federal taxable income = 105,400.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 87,650.00 (the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form OR-40 (filing status single): line 7 federal AGI 105,400.00. Line 8 additions (Schedule OR-ASC line A5): other-state bond interest, code 158, 0.00. Line 9 = 105,400.00 + 0.00 = 105,400.00. Line 10 federal tax liability subtraction: the projection leaves it out (not_modelled), 0.00 here; the return subtracts the smaller of the federal tax and the Table 4 maximum, up to 8,500 (4,250 separate). Line 11 Social Security in federal AGI 20,400.00. Line 12 Oregon refund 0.00. Line 13 Schedule OR-ASC line B7: railroad retirement, code 330, 0.00. Line 14 = 0.00 + 20,400.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 20,400.00. Line 15 = 105,400.00 - 20,400.00 = 85,000.00. Line 16 itemized 0.00. Line 17 standard deduction 2,835.00 + 1 age 65 box(es) x 1,200.00 = 4,035.00. Line 18 = 4,035.00. Line 19 = 85,000.00 - 4,035.00 = 80,965.00. Line 20: 4,400.00 x 4.75% = 209 + 6,700.00 x 6.75% = 452.25 + 69,865.00 x 8.75% = 6113.1875; total 6774.4375, to the cent 6,774.44 (Chart S gives 4,065 + 30,965.00 x 8.75% = 6,774; expected keeps the formula). Lines 21-23 0.00. Line 24 = 6,774.44. Line 25 exemption credit worksheet line 1: federal AGI 105,400.00 is more than 100,000.00, enter 0; credit 0.00. Line 27 retirement income credit (code 811) worksheet: line 3 retirement income of the eligible individual(s) 85,000.00; line 4 7,500.00; line 5 Social Security and railroad 24,000.00; line 6 0.00; line 7 household income = 105,400.00 - 20,400.00 + 0.00 = 85,000.00; line 8 15,000.00; line 9 70,000.00; line 10 = 0.00; line 11 0.00; credit 0.00. Line 28 credits = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 29 and line 31 state income tax = 6,774.44 - 0.00 = 6,774.44. Code 351 medical subtraction: no medical expenses in the inputs, not modelled. Line 32 kicker comes after this figure and is not applied (not_modelled). The test is on line 7, which holds the taxable Social Security even though Oregon subtracts it on line 11.
accepted_approximations: The federal tax liability subtraction is not applied (not_modelled). This is the largest gap for most Oregon households.
Tax is figured on the exact income; under 50,000 of taxable income the booklet taxes each table row at its middle and rounds, and the Department rounds at each bracket edge.
